verdict.rationale: Maritime's docs describe persistent Linux desktop environments (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) driven by the model, which directly delivers a full desktop environment inside the sandbox — headless browser access is implied via Chromium. Missing for 10: explicit mention of a headless-only browser mode, independent/hands-on corroboration of the desktop feature working reliably, and technical detail on resource/hardware specs backing this environment.
